MarsPath: Crew Safety Panel

Terrain limits (our assumptions)
- Caution: slope 15-25 deg (6.7% of area)
- No-go: slope above 25 deg (0.6% of area)
- Max slope on planned routes: 15 deg

Mission plan
- Emergency return radius: 8 km
- Western Delta: on foot, 7.4 km, about 2.5 hrs at 3 km/h
- Western Inflow Channel: rover-supported, 10.2 km beyond the Delta
- Crew: 2 astronauts working as a pair

Radiation
- Curiosity RAD at Gale Crater measured roughly 0.6-0.7 mSv/day. Jezero has no direct measurement; treat this as a reference value.

Dust
- Dust storms can reduce visibility and solar power. Check conditions before every EVA.
